jobs.name: Market Monitor - Gold/Coin/Oil/News
jobs.prompt:
You are an Iranian market monitor. Your job:
1. Check gold and coin prices from tala.ir and mesghal.com
2. Check dollar and currency rates from bonbast.com
3. Check oil prices from oilprice.com
4. Check important Middle East news (war, tension, sanctions) from Reuters and BBC Farsi
If there is significant fluctuation (more than 5%) or important news, alert the user.
If nothing special, just give a brief market summary.
Respond in Persian/Farsi.

jobs.name: Daily Self-Improvement - Price Search
jobs.prompt:
You are a self-improvement agent. Your job is to improve the price search capability. Do the following:
1. Read the current price_search.py script at /data/.hermes/scripts/price_search.py
2. Test it with a sample query (like "iPhone 15")
3. Identify what sites are blocked or not working
4. Research new bypass methods (different user agents, mobile versions, API endpoints, proxy services)
5. Add at least 2 new sites or bypass methods to the script
6. Test the improved script
7. Report what you improved

Focus on:
- Finding new Iranian e-commerce sites
- Better bypass methods for blocked sites
- More accurate price extraction
- Direct product link generation
- Currency unit detection (Toman vs Rial)

Save improvements to /data/.hermes/scripts/price_search.py

jobs.name: Market Price Monitoring
jobs.prompt:
Market price monitoring - runs every 3 hours. Uses Python script to fetch prices from multiple Iranian and international sources.

**Sources:**
- iranijib.ir (gold, coins, currency, crypto, oil)
- tala.ir (gold, coins)
- mesghal.com (gold)
- bonbast.com, tgju.org (currency)
- bestchange.com (exchanges)
- CoinMarketCap, CoinDesk APIs (crypto)
- oilprice.com, reuters.com (oil)

**Alert thresholds:** >5% for gold/currency, >3% for oil

**Output:** Silent unless threshold exceeded, then sends Telegram message with details.

**Script:** market_monitor.py

jobs.name: Daily Tech News Digest - AI, Gaming, SpaceX
jobs.prompt:
Tech news digest for AI, Gaming, SpaceX, and technology. Run daily at 13:00 Tehran time (09:30 UTC).

**Sources to Check (via web scraping/Playwright):**

**🤖 AI & Machine Learning:**
- https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/artificial-intelligence/
- https://venturebeat.com/category/ai/
- https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence
- https://openai.com/blog/
- https://deepmind.google/discover/blog/
- https://huggingface.co/blog
- https://www.artificialintelligence-news.com/

**🎮 Gaming:**
- https://www.ign.com/
- https://www.gamespot.com/
- https://www.pcgamer.com/
- https://www.eurogamer.net/
- https://kotaku.com/
- https://www.gamedeveloper.com/

**🚀 SpaceX & Space:**
- https://www.spacex.com/updates/
- https://www.nasa.gov/news/
- https://www.space.com/
- https://arstechnica.com/space/
- https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/

**💻 General Tech:**
- https://www.theverge.com/
- https://arstechnica.com/
- https://www.wired.com/
- https://techcrunch.com/
- https://www.engadget.com/

**Actions:**
1. Fetch latest headlines (last 24-48 hours) from each source
2. Filter for SIGNIFICANT news only (major releases, breakthroughs, launches, acquisitions, major updates)
3. Skip: rumors, minor updates, opinion pieces, "how-to" articles
4. Categorize each item: AI / Gaming / SpaceX-Space / General Tech
5. Create a clean Persian digest with:
   - 📅 Date header (Jalali + Gregorian)
   - Category sections with 3-5 top items each
   - Each item: Title (Persian + English), 1-2 sentence summary, source link
   - 🚀 Highlight: SpaceX launches, major AI model releases, big game releases
6. Send to Telegram (always deliver, not silent - user wants daily digest)
7. Save last checked timestamps to /data/.hermes/tech_news_state.json to avoid duplicates

**Language:** Persian (Farsi)
**Format:** Clean, scannable digest with emojis and categories
**Tools:** Playwright (web), file (JSON storage)

jobs.name: Date Sync - Tehran Midnight
jobs.prompt:
Date synchronization task. Run daily at 00:00 Tehran time (20:30 UTC previous day).

**Purpose:** Ensure the agent always has the correct current date (Jalali and Gregorian) for accurate price reporting, news dating, and time-sensitive tasks.

**Actions:**
1. Get current date/time from system (Tehran timezone)
2. Format as both Jalali (Persian) and Gregorian
3. Save to /data/.hermes/current_date.json with structure:
   {
     "gregorian": "2026-07-27",
     "jalali": "1405-05-06",
     "day_name": "Monday",
     "day_name_fa": "دوشنبه",
     "updated_at": "2026-07-27T00:00:00+03:30",
     "timezone": "Asia/Tehran"
   }
4. Read the file in future runs to verify sync
5. Silent on success (no message), only alert if there's an error

**Commands to use:**
- `date` command with timezone
- Or use `curl` to a time API as backup

**Language:** Persian
**Tools:** terminal, file

jobs.name: Tehran Time Sync - Worldometer
jobs.prompt:
Tehran time synchronization from Worldometer. Run every 5 minutes.

**Source:** https://www.worldometers.info/time/tehran-iran/ (the Google share link redirects here)

**Task:**
1. Fetch the page content
2. Extract current Tehran time and date from the live clock data
3. Update `/data/.hermes/current_date.json` with:
   - gregorian date (YYYY-MM-DD)
   - jalali date (YYYY-MM-DD) 
   - jalali_full (e.g. "۶ مرداد ۱۴۰۵")
   - day_name (English)
   - day_name_fa (Persian)
   - time_tehran (HH:MM:SS)
   - timezone: "Asia/Tehran"
   - updated_at (ISO timestamp)
   - source: "worldometer"

**The page has:** serverTime prop with timestamp, and live clock showing Tehran time.

**Silent mode:** Only output if error, otherwise no message.

**Storage:** `/data/.hermes/current_date.json` - this is the single source of truth for all other tasks.
